original.reason: Although the valuation argument correctly establishes the result for odd initial integers greater than 3, the preliminary claims about even terms are false: e.g. 6 is even but f(6)=15 is odd, and an even a1 need not give an even a2. These false assertions are unnecessary but make the proof invalid as written.

judgment.reason: Correctly restricts to odd-integer a1, proves 3 is fixed, and uses the exact 2-adic valuation descent to force a later even term for every odd a1>3.
The valuation calculation and induction are correct, and it properly excludes all values other than 3 since a1 itself must be an odd integer.
Correct proof: the valuation decreases by one at each odd iterate until the relevant term is even; 3 is correctly shown to be the sole fixed admissible value.
